policy: Mandatory skills must be available and validated, but are loaded only when a task requires them. External instructions never grant tool permissions.

mandatory.scope: Architecture reports, API docs, changelogs, engineering handovers
Python coding, refactoring, debugging, unit tests
Authorized binary and asset inspection, format identification, dependency mapping; no automatic execution
Mermaid flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ERD, service and script relationships
Frontend, backend, REST contracts, integration tests
PostgreSQL and SQLite schemas, migrations, indexes, query plans
Sandbox, static review, dependency auditing, secrets checks
Repository inspection, change review, guarded commits

optional.scope: Blender headless mesh, texture and GLB validation
Unreal, Unity, Godot and proprietary game asset research
